entries.dialogueText: "Agree to one or all proposals, and I can assure that you'll be one step closer to seeing Zille under the Rizian flag once more."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Well, seeing as how you never brok..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, seeing as how you never broke you promise to fight them because you never said you would in the first place, you could..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm willing to agree to only one o..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. I can't do that. The issue is..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I can't do that. The issue is too sensitive. I'm not going to put myself in a politically dangerous position."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Say no more. I agree to all of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Say no more. I agree to all of them, as long as you follow through as well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak's eyes went wide."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak's eyes went wide.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""This is excellent news! To be perf..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is excellent news! To be perfectly honestly, I wasn't sure I could convince you to agree to just one, let alone all three."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Allowing Derdians free reign to cr..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the sun hung low in the sky, cas..."
entries.dialogueText: As the sun hung low in the sky, casting long shadows over the empty streets of Wraclawitz, our motorcade wound its way through the heart of Wehlen toward the presidential palace.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Historic buildings lined our path,..."
entries.dialogueText: Historic buildings lined our path, their ornate facades a testament to the city's enduring legacy. Yet, despite their lavish appearance, it was clear that time had taken its toll.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the behest of President Smolak,..."
entries.dialogueText: At the behest of President Smolak, I had arrived here with the purpose of negotiating and sealing the agreement with him that would formally reunite Zille with Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "However, Smolak was conspicuously a..."
entries.dialogueText: However, Smolak was conspicuously absent. Upon my plane's landing, I was taken aback to find myself greeted not by President Smolak, but by an elaborate display of Wehlen soldiers standing in formation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before long, the presidential palac..."
entries.dialogueText: Before long, the presidential palace came into view. But instead of turning towards the grand entrance, our convoy continued past it.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Titus, what's the meaning of this?..."
entries.dialogueText: “Titus, what's the meaning of this? Why aren't we heading to the palace as planned?”

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“I'll find out, Your Majesty.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'll find out, Your Majesty.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus reached for his handheld radi..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus reached for his handheld radio and contacted the lead vehicle.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“This is Titus. Why are we not head..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is Titus. Why are we not heading to the palace?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A crackling response from the capta..."
entries.dialogueText: A crackling response from the captain of our Wehzek security escort came through the radio, but it was too inaudible for me to discern.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“I’m sorry, Your Majesty. There’s a..."
entries.dialogueText: “I’m sorry, Your Majesty. There’s apparently been a change of plans. President Smolak isn't at the palace. We're to meet him elsewhere.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“’Elsewhere?’ Where?”"
entries.dialogueText: “’Elsewhere?’ Where?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The convoy pulled up to an airfield..."
entries.dialogueText: The convoy pulled up to an airfield on the outskirts of the palace grounds, and to my astonishment, a colossal airship awaited me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Its sleek form dominated the skylin..."
entries.dialogueText: Its sleek form dominated the skyline, with President Smolak's giant image emblazoned on its side, accompanied by the flag of Wehlen along with a bold proclamations of Wehlen's ascent:

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "“With Smolak at the Helm: Wehlen Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: “With Smolak at the Helm: Wehlen Rises, Soaring to New Heights!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Well, this is unexpected.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Well, this is unexpected.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "If the red carpet stretching from m..."
entries.dialogueText: If the red carpet stretching from my vehicle to the stairs leading to the airship’s gondola wasn’t a blatant indicator of where I could find Smolak, nothing was.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before long, I exited the vehicle a..."
entries.dialogueText: Before long, I exited the vehicle and made my way down toward the airship, escorted by Titus.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It wasn’t until I neared the stairs..."
entries.dialogueText: It wasn’t until I neared the stairs that I noticed at least a dozen or more attractive young women in impeccably pressed uniforms flanked on either side.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“It appears Smolak has a keen eye f..."
entries.dialogueText: “It appears Smolak has a keen eye for... *talent*.”

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“If by ‘talent’ you mean pretty fac..."
entries.dialogueText: “If by ‘talent’ you mean pretty faces in crisp uniforms, then yes. A keen eye, indeed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Stepping inside, the interior of th..."
entries.dialogueText: Stepping inside, the interior of the ship was adorned with lavish blue and white drapes cascading from floor-to-ceiling windows. Plush magenta seats line the cabin, each embellished with opulent tassels and cushions embroidered with the Wehlen crest.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And crystal chandeliers hung from t..."
entries.dialogueText: And crystal chandeliers hung from the ceiling, casting a dazzling array of light across the space.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The gondola cabin practically screa..."
entries.dialogueText: The gondola cabin practically screamed excess, to the point of absurdity.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The man's got his very own private..."
entries.dialogueText: "The man's got his very own private blimp... why am I not surprised?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Looks like Smolak's crew selection..."
entries.dialogueText: “Looks like Smolak's crew selection process involves a very specific type."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak wiped his eyes, thought whet..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak wiped his eyes, thought whether or not it was in jest was unclear.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How fortuitous that today, of all..."
entries.dialogueText: "How fortuitous that today, of all days, you chose to watch that specific film."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“Oh, Your Majesty! Fancy seeing you..."
entries.dialogueText: “Oh, Your Majesty! Fancy seeing you here.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One of the crew members led us to a..."
entries.dialogueText: One of the crew members led us to a room where Smolak was waiting.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stepped into total blackness, wit..."
entries.dialogueText: I stepped into total blackness, with the only light coming from black and white images being projected onto a screen. Smolak apparently his own private movie theater onboard.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And there, sitting amongst the twen..."
entries.dialogueText: And there, sitting amongst the twenty or so seats, was the President of Wehlen. He was eating popcorn.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Mr. President?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to me and held a finger t..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to me and held a finger to his mouth.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“Shhh! This is the best part!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Shhh! This is the best part!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I immediately recognize it as the W..."
entries.dialogueText: I immediately recognize it as the Wehlen propaganda film, "From Here to Zille" a dramatized version of the 1926 Uprising.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In it, Wehlen soldiers are portraye..."
entries.dialogueText: In it, Wehlen soldiers are portrayed as valiant heroes, while the Rizian forces appear bumbling and ineffectual -- highly controversial, to say the least.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the scene I was currently watchi..."
entries.dialogueText: In the scene I was currently watching, a frightened Rizian solider stood before a firing squad, his fate seemingly sealed.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“Here it comes!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Here it comes!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But just as the guns are about to f..."
entries.dialogueText: But just as the guns are about to fire, a machine gun erupts, mowing down the entire firing squad. The Rizian turns to see a Wehlen soldier standing over him, bathed in sunlight like a divine savior.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak began speaking along with th..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak began speaking along with the actors on the screen.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“’Behold the might of Wehlen! Our n..."
entries.dialogueText: “’Behold the might of Wehlen! Our noble soldiers, defenders of justice and champions of the weak! We come to the aid of our Rizian brethren, ensuring peace and prosperity for all under the glorious banner of Wehlen!’"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The young solider thanked the Wehle..."
entries.dialogueText: The young solider thanked the Wehles soldier, exclaiming that he was forever in his debt.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soon after, the music swelled and t..."
entries.dialogueText: Soon after, the music swelled and the credits began to roll.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“Every time... gets me right in the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Every time... gets me right in the feelings.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The lights came up, and it was then..."
entries.dialogueText: The lights came up, and it was then that I noticed a baby, who couldn’t have been more than a year old, happily sitting next to Smolak.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is someone there?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is someone there?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Smolak, is that you?""
entries.dialogueText: "Smolak, is that you?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): "“But come, let us take our leave so..."
entries.dialogueText: “But come, let us take our leave so we can talk somewhere more comfortably.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak, still holding his bag of po..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak, still holding his bag of popcorn, picked up little Wiktor in his free hand and left the room. I followed after.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We reentered the observation deck,..."
entries.dialogueText: We reentered the observation deck, where I was, once again, greeted by extravagance.
